name: Camping 101: Fishing

angles.text: Learn the basics of cooking before making camp. Cooking trainers teach travelers to build the campfire a campsite needs.

faq.answer: You learn to make a Fish Bowl and prepare a wilderness resting place for fishing. Set up away from settlements.
faq.q: What do you learn from Camping 101: Fishing?

faq.answer: Set up in the wilderness, beyond town borders. Townsfolk object when travelers spread their gear through public thoroughfares.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

faq.answer: Have a campfire ready for warmth. A campsite needs one to be complete.
faq.q: What do you need before pitching a camp?

faq.answer: Cooking trainers teach you how to make a campfire. If you have not learned the basics of cooking, seek a cook for instruction.
faq.q: How do you learn to build a campfire?

faq.answer: The Fish Bowl decorates an outdoor campsite and suits an angler resting by the water.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Fish Bowl?

faq.answer: Wilderness mentors teach practical frontier skills, including making fires and respecting settlement boundaries before you head into the wild.
faq.q: Why are camping lessons taught to adventurers?

sections.body: Travel through Azeroth calls for a little knowledge of the wild. When you need a place to rest, keep your tent and gear beyond town borders. Townsfolk and guards dislike travelers spreading their belongings through settlements. Take your supplies into the open wilderness instead.
sections.title: Wilderness Etiquette

sections.body: A proper campsite needs a few comforts. Start with a warm campfire; a cooking trainer can teach you how to make one. Once the fire is ready, set out a handcrafted Fish Bowl. Then your stop is fit for an angler.
sections.title: The Comforts of Camp

summary: You’re preparing for wilderness fishing with a Fish Bowl and a campfire. Learn where to set up and what makes a resting place comfortable.
